title: Design Day #10 — Retail Design
description:
The theme for Aug 2013's Design Day is:

RETAIL SPACE DESIGN

NOTE: We will be charging 100 INR/- per person at Idiom Design on Sat 24th Aug in order to gain entrance to the event.

The agenda includes:
1. A Story: By an experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of a career in Design.

This time we have Sonia Manchanda, co-founder Idiom sharing her design journey with us.

2. Tutorial/Skill Building Session: By an experienced Designer to teach us something new.

We'll have Raji Math and team from Idiom taking us through the various stages of thinking and planning that goes behind the design of an appealing shopping marvel.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people.

Given that this Design Day will be held at Idiom, we'll give you a tour of the place instead of a jam. We will try our best to accommodate a Jam if time persists.

We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

This event is strictly for designers. Its fine if you are a beginner and want to learn.

Cheers,

Amit/Kavita/Aashish
